verdict.rationale: Kong provides an official, documented MCP server (Konnect MCP) with regional endpoints, and a hands-on probe confirms it is live and auth-gated (returns proper JSON-RPC 401 rather than failing to respond), plus Kong Gateway/AI Gateway offer MCP autogeneration, governance, and security features for agent connectivity. missing for 10: independent third-party or community corroboration of successful authenticated connection/usage by an external agent, and more detail on the connection setup flow beyond the handshake probe.
